title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of this committee by the Badminton Association of India ensures greater representation and a stronger voice for Indian badminton players in decision-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at giving players a more direct role in the sport's governance and development. This initiative is expected to foster better communication and address player concerns more effectively.

title: Junior Squad Trains for World Championships at Guwahati Camp
indian_angle: Indian junior players are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing to represent the nation at the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: India's top junior badminton talents have gathered at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati for a crucial coaching camp, focusing on preparations for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026. The camp aims to hone their skills and strategies for international competition.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Concludes Successfully
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course conducted by BAI aims to uplift the standard of coaching across India, directly benefiting the development of future Indian badminton stars.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course across two National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, concluding on September 23rd. The program focused on enhancing coaching methodologies and player development techniques.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials Announced
indian_angle: This notification directly impacts the composition of India's women's doubles contingent for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships, highlighting the rigorous selection process.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued an important notification regarding a change in the women's doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, ensuring fair and transparent selection.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Events
indian_angle: This significant rule change in domestic junior tournaments will reshape strategy and player development for young Indian shuttlers, aligning with potential future international trends.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups, effective from June 30th, 2026.
